evals.name: default_20_question_exam
evals.prompt: Tạo đề ôn tập AI Thực Chiến tổng hợp
assertions: Initializes or reuses a study repository
Creates exam and answer markdown files before writing content
Uses Vietnamese with full diacritics in generated exam content
Does not ask the user to choose Day folders for a broad exam request
Uses the default mixed blueprint when no topic is specified
Includes common section and Business/Infrastructure/App Build coverage
Uses MCQ, multi-select, fill-in-blank, and scenario or code items
Does not include answer key inline in the student-facing exam

evals.name: custom_count_topic
evals.prompt: Tạo 12 câu ôn RAGAS và guardrails, có đáp án riêng
assertions: Creates markdown files in the study repository
Separates student questions from answer key
Tags topics and difficulty in answer key

evals.name: grade_and_update_kb
evals.prompt: Chấm bài mock exam này và cập nhật knowledge base
assertions: Scores answers with rubric where needed
Updates learner knowledge base without deleting prior history
